faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSL Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSL Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden positions is 01 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 36,500/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 3 Year Diploma or Degree from a recognized university. Knowledge in counselling is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 58 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for this post.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden position in Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee for this recruitment. The fee is Nil for these categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Female Hostel Superintendent / Warden post will primarily involve a Practical Test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contract job. The selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the job location in Kerala. While not explicitly stated that only Kerala residents can apply, candidates from other states should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and are willing to relocate.
